ns2:section.sectionText: Students will utilize a combination of Moodle lessons, Blackboard Collaborate-based discussion sections and office hours, and required e-book access. Students are required to attend one of the two Blackboard Collaborate sessions on Fridays. Two proctored hourly exams and a proctored final exam will be given either on campus or via ProctorU. This section will have one or more proctored online exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU, approved proctoring centers, and approved testing facilities that carry no fees.
